G'oya

Bitta guruhdan uchta son kerak: COUNT(*), MIN(price) va MAX(price). Ular bitta GROUP BY category ichida yonma-yon hisoblanadi, har biri uchun alohida so'rov yozish shart emas.

Yechim

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS products, MIN(price) AS min_price, MAX(price) AS max_price
FROM products
GROUP BY category

Namunada Oziq-ovqat: 3 ta mahsulot, eng arzoni 4 000, eng qimmati 25 000. Kategoriyasiz Sovg'a NULL guruhda yolg'iz, shuning uchun uning eng arzon va eng qimmat narxi bir xil: 50 000.

Tuzoqlar

WHERE category IS NOT NULL yozmang. Shart kategoriyasiz mahsulotlarni alohida guruh qilib ko'rsatishni so'rayapti.

COUNT(DISTINCT price) mahsulotlarni emas, har xil narxlarni sanaydi. Bir kategoriyada ikki mahsulot 5 000 so'mdan tursa, ular baribir ikkita mahsulot:

Noto'g'riSELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT price) AS products, MIN(price) AS min_price, MAX(price) AS max_price
FROM products
GROUP BY category

Ustunlar tartibiga ham qarang. Tekshiruvchi ustun nomlarini emas, o'rnini solishtiradi: MAX(price) AS min_price deb yozilsa ham, uchinchi ustunda eng qimmat narx turadi va javob noto'g'ri bo'ladi.
